read: 2026-10-18, by eye from the schematic in the Revolution Deux post
comment: Hand-drawn by Fred Briggs (the blog author) in 2012 from Greg's freestompboxes.org trace. The drawing has no designators; R1-R6, C1-C5, Q1-Q3 and D2-D3 follow roseblood11's 'Fuzzy Carla' vero layout (image 7), and the two filter capacitors are numbered C6 and C7 here.
uncertain: The vero layout's parts list differs from the schematic: it has a 100n ceramic and 220u filter capacitor where the schematic has 47u and 100u, adds a 1N4001 (D1) and an LED resistor, and lists the clipping diodes as BAT46 and 1N914.
